name: Butternut Squash Cumin Soup with Ghee Tarka
description: A silky butternut squash cumin soup built on French velouté technique and finished with a Pakistani ghee tarka of whole cumin seeds and Kashmiri chilli. Deep, warming, and ready in 55 minutes.
keywords: butternut squash cumin soup, veloute de courge, roasted cumin squash soup, spiced butternut soup, ghee tarka, halal soup
recipeIngredient: 1 kg (2.2 lb) butternut squash, peeled and cut into 3 cm cubes
900 ml (3¾ cups) chicken or vegetable stock
Small handful of fresh coriander leaves
A few drops of lemon juice per bowl

recipeInstructions.name: Roast the squash
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C / 400°F. Toss the cubed squash with 1 tbsp oil and a generous pinch of salt. Spread on a baking tray in a single layer. Roast for 25 to 30 minutes until the edges are caramelized and the flesh is completely soft.

recipeInstructions.name: Sweat the aromatics
recipeInstructions.text: Warm the remaining 1 tbsp oil in a large saucepan over medium-low heat. Add the onion with a pinch of salt and cook for 12 to 15 minutes until soft and pale gold. Add the garlic and cook for another 2 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Add the dry spices
recipeInstructions.text: Stir in the ground coriander, turmeric, and white pepper. Cook for 60 seconds, stirring constantly, until fragrant.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine and simmer
recipeInstructions.text: Add the roasted squash and the stock to the pot. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 10 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend until smooth
recipeInstructions.text: Use a stick blender or standing blender and blend for at least 90 seconds until completely smooth and coating the back of a spoon.

recipeInstructions.name: Add cream and adjust seasoning
recipeInstructions.text: Return the pot to low heat. Stir in the double cream and heat gently without boiling. Taste and correct the salt. Add a few drops of lemon juice if the soup tastes flat.

recipeInstructions.name: Make the tarka
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the ghee in a small pan over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the cumin seeds and cook for 20 to 30 seconds until crackling and one shade darker. Remove from heat, add the Kashmiri chilli powder and hing, and swirl once.

recipeInstructions.name: Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Ladle the soup into warm bowls. Pour the tarka over the surface of each bowl. Finish with coriander leaves and a drop of lemon juice. Serve immediately.
